description: This file contains various functions for checking system configurations, dependencies, permissions, and environment suitability for a PHP-based web application, specifically testing configurations, database schema versions, security notes, and server capabilities within the TestLink project.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Represents a user in the system with methods to read from the database and compare passwords.

methods.name: get_home_url
methods.description: Constructs and returns the base URL of the application, considering protocol, host, port, and path, adapted from Mantis Bugtracker.

methods.name: checkServerLanguageSettings
methods.description: Determines the preferred language based on HTTP headers.

methods.name: checkConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if the main configuration database file exists; redirects to installer if missing.

methods.name: checkInstallStatus
methods.description: Checks if the installation has been completed based on definition of a constant.

methods.name: checkLibGd
methods.description: Verifies if GD PNG support is available.

methods.name: checkForExtensions
methods.description: Ensures necessary PHP extensions are loaded.

methods.name: checkForInstallDir
methods.description: Checks existence of the installation directory.

methods.name: checkForAdminDefaultPwd
methods.description: Verifies if the admin password is still at its default value.

methods.name: checkForLDAPExtension
methods.description: Checks if LDAP extension is loaded.

methods.name: getSecurityNotes
methods.description: Gathers security-related warnings based on current system configuration.

methods.name: checkForBTSConnection
methods.description: Verifies connection to Bug Tracking System database.

methods.name: isMSWindowsServer
methods.description: Detects if the server OS is Microsoft Windows.

methods.name: checkForRepositoryDir
methods.description: Verifies if a repository directory exists and is writable.

methods.name: checkSchemaVersion
methods.description: Checks if the database schema version matches the latest supported version.

methods.name: checkEmailConfig
methods.description: Validates email configuration parameters.

methods.name: check_php_settings
methods.description: Checks PHP settings such as max execution time, memory limit, and register_globals.

methods.name: checkPhpExtensions
methods.description: Verifies availability of common PHP extensions necessary for the application.

methods.name: check_session
methods.description: Checks if PHP sessions are properly configured.

methods.name: check_timeout
methods.description: Checks PHP session timeout configuration.

methods.name: checkDbType
methods.description: Validates that the specified database type is supported.

methods.name: checkServerOs
methods.description: Outputs the server OS.

methods.name: checkPhpVersion
methods.description: Ensures PHP version meets the minimum required.

methods.name: check_file_permissions
methods.description: Verifies if specific files are writable or readable depending on install state.

methods.name: check_dir_permissions
methods.description: Checks if certain directories exist and have appropriate permissions.

methods.name: reportCheckingBrowser
methods.description: Generates a report on browser support and JavaScript availability.

methods.name: reportCheckingSystem
methods.description: Displays server OS and PHP version information.

methods.name: reportCheckingDatabase
methods.description: Outputs database configuration and support checks.

methods.name: reportCheckingWeb
methods.description: Includes PHP configuration and environment checks.

methods.name: reportCheckingPermissions
methods.description: Displays file and directory permission checks.
